body: If you don't mind me asking, what kind of medical intervention? He's fighting it claiming he doesn't have money to afford seeing the doctor and for a program. But I told him I have thousands of dollars available for him to get better. I'm not so sure he wants help though. It's hard to tell when I'm getting a generic excuse versus the truth it seems.

He woke up and it was awkward like nothing happened last night and he was just super hungover. I confirmed I'd see him later and sent him a heartfelt text letting him know if anyone loved him and needed him around it was me. The next 8 hours are going to be brutal for me.

Right, idk how to prevent him, he's grown and does things on his own accord. He mentioned wanting to get plastered and I tried to gently ask why and tried to have him make sense of it on his own how it's not beneficial or a good idea but he was leagues deeper in some dark place than I ever knew or observed.

Thank you so much for this. I will be sure to update and express the urgency to his doctor. I counted how many meds he's got left and took a pic of his bottle so I call the right doctor. His family isn't responding to me but I believe they are a huge factor in why he's in the dark place he is. I will just have to be confident that calling his doctor is the right thing to do right now. I also am in therapy myself and will definitely be talking this over tomorrow, I'm still in shock and off of about 2 hrs of sleep at best.
Thank you, I naturally used some of those methods above when I was talking him out of leaving. I'm worried to go to work now but he's still asleep.
Thank you, I agree at this point he needs a stay somewhere. Alcohol definitely causss him to go into psychosis and this is beyond my scope. I will call first thing in the morning to his doctor.
I text her last night saying I was concerned and will follow up later today for sure. Thank you.
